title: Watch A Video, Provide Email & Mobile Number & Receive $20 90-Day StoreCash @ The Good Guys
body:
Deal: Watch A Video, Provide Email & Mobile Number & Receive $20 90-Day StoreCash @ The Good Guys

[shxhshzhz] Link goes to entering a draw for a kitchen package. Where is the $20 credit section?
[webtonmoy] Select the arrow next to the video panel after watching the video. It's not the most user-friendly interface!
[Tinky Winky] Once you've submitted your entry, a pop up saying thanks here's $20 will appear
[Aap Ke Papa] Still showed up though in the wallet. Expiry December 30th
[3sky] @Aap Ke Papa: Got it, cheers! expiry 03 Dec for me
[ozrain101] @life is suffering: Check your wallet. If you already signed up for the good guys wallet it might be there. I didnt get sms but have the $20 in the good guys wallet
[biznis] @ozrain101: ahh nice, showed up for me too…happy days
[bonezAU] @biznis: All days in WA are happy days. The east coaster's don't even know what they're missing out on.
This message is going to cause chaos.
As you were.
[HairyChickens] How long does it take for the store cash SMS to come through?
[HairyChickens] Never activated store cash for TGG before, but the SMS came in about 2 minutes.
Thanks OP
[Big-Deal] Haven't received SMS for about 5 mins now
[6079 Smith] Just click the banner t the top of their website to activate your digital wallet and the $20 will be there
I never got an SMS
[SquareCereal724] a cheap spare mouse for the computer, there is a dell one for $15: https://www.thegoodguys.com.au/dell-wireless-mouse-wm126-bla… and a mousepad for $5: https://www.thegoodguys.com.au/crest-desk-mouse-mat-black-ci…
or you could get a charging cable or a HDMI cable
[just-human] Did you set your preferred store as one in WA?
[FLICKIT] Worked, thanks ! (set preferred store to a tassie store)
[pavman] Anyone know if this voucher will work with TGG Commercial?
[CodeXD] Qualifying conditions, including signing up to 90 Day StoreCash, activating a Digital Wallet before being eligible to earn/win
how do we sign up to the 90 Day StoreCash and activating digital wallet?
[TheDukeOfNukem] I think they just mean you need an existing Google / Apple Wallet. I had some StoreCash from them a year or two back and it was just added to my Google Wallet like any other pass, then scanned in store.
[jalalii] So existing store cash wallets aren’t eligible?
[Chickenleg] I had an existing wallet that i used for the first time this morning and just checked it and it had the $20 in it after watching the vid. Didn't get SMS.
Edit: Received sms after about 5 minutes but didn't need it anyway
[A female dog] Would the $20 credit work with this deal
[Chickenleg] Yes, i stacked storecash and $40 voucher in store today.
[treeman] Do they still have Netflix gift cards at good guys or are they ineligible?
[theg00s3] voucher showed up in my storecash pass in the wallet app immediately
[PR0r] Did you receive an SMS after giving your details?
One more surprise — As a thank you for entering and signing up to 90 Day StoreCash>, we've loaded $20 90 Day StoreCash> into your Digital Wallet! To access it, simply activate your wallet via the SMS we sent you.
I'm not getting any SMS ☹️
[theg00s3] I got this SMS (I was an existing member if that makes any difference)
Great news, your 90 Day StoreCash is now available in your digital wallet - it's single use & has a 90-day expiry.
T&Cs http://tgg.au/r/B2/2bpoV4/2
[io] You will not get SMS if your TTG store cash digital wallet is already activated.
[BargainsGrabber] Doesn’t work for existing storecash members. Tried on a brand new number and it appeared immediately but an existing storecash account still waiting
[PR0r] Hmm I'm the opposite, I'm not a storecash member and nothings appeared.
At the bottom of the page it mentions this which I'm not sure how to interpret it for this specific $20 promo.
Qualifying conditions, including signing up to 90 Day StoreCash, activating a Digital Wallet before being eligible to earn/win and where a qualifying purchase is required,
[Avalanche] Worked for me on existing storecash account. Thanks OP
[io] Worked on my existing account. Took me 15 min though.
[burningrage] I am not getting any SMS lol
EDIT: Nvm, I got it now. Thanks OP!
[Optimus Prime] For anyone not receiving an SMS . use this link https://www.thegoodguys.com.au/storecash?srsltid=AfmBOorXatfKsJF4h6XvxKcQ9AY0ykNHE_B0fE2Q_rcZTDKVjp2LI6oG and click "Activate/Check my digital wallet". It will prompt for your mobile number and you will be able to see the $20 storecash . you will then get an SMS with link to add to the wallet
[nicholasv] Received text within 2 minutes for a new phone number sign up. My main account hasn't got anything though
[edrift] I activated the wallet but didn't get the $20.
What am I missing?
[edrift] Yep. I clicked the link to activate the wallet from there and it added to my Google wallet.
But when I click the other link to check the balance I have none
[io] Same here. But after waiting 15 min it is there.
[mayo88] Just got the store credit added to the wallet. It took 15mins
[life is suffering] You can apply for delivery driver position 😅
[jimojr] Looking at your username, I thought you’d be the last person to worry about a delivery fee. 😂
[Coolhandlucas] Just bought one of these retractable USB-C cables for $19, thanks OP
https://www.thegoodguys.com.au/baseus-free2pull-100w-cable-c…

[xdivino] Watched the video an hour ago - filled it out and entered the comp - no sms - went to check balance on the website - still nada - downvoting till rectified.
[SydOzber] is there a way to contact via email ? can't find any
[UncleRico] Patience, young padawan…
Good things come…
[T-man] Never received the sms, watched the video again and now got the message “only one entry is allowed”, that means they got my info but never sent the storecash
[UncleRico] Easy on the negs, tiger.
I didn't receive the SMS yet either, but when I log into my account, I can see it's there.
I'm sure the SMS will come, even if it takes a little longer than the average tik tok video…
[superforever] Wnners will be drawn on 29/09/2026.
So draw only, not a bargain
[bcYield] Someone said they received in minutes. Bait or error?
[Winny182] …that’s for the $50,000 kitchen and appliances competition
[Xmandu] Maybe you have a spam section for your SMS. Check that too.
[Lordeee] To anyone who uses Google wallet, you can check if it's been added to your account by -> View more -> The good guys pass -> 3 dots top right side and should say about "$20 Kinsman Watch and Win 90 Day StoreCash"
[fedwood] Worked instantly in my Google wallet good guys account.
[discountgoblin] Thanks OP. Don't forget to enable topcashback for 3%. money's money!
[cook99] I love the idea of some cheap ozbargainer who just wanted a free $20 winning a $50k kitchen…

[Dollar Dreamer] The winner will probably be the competition organisers cousin.
[SuHao] Can we stack two at a single transaction?
